x: Our team was Ken O'Kell(3), Mick Pyer(4), Bert Footer(8), Jack Andrews (17), Bert Smith(21), Harry Bruce(26). Our 79 points gave us a two point win over Epsom H, with Surrey AC third.

Then came the "turn-up" in J.Andrews who showed wonderful improvement and helped considerably to withstand the efforts of our Epsom friends so that eventually we ran out winners of our first Cross Country Championship by a margin of 2 points.

Labels on photo: A.E.SMITH, G.F.EASTON, J.G.FLATT, W.A.RICE, A.D.PYER, H.W.BRUCE, J.D.ANDREWS, W.H.WILLIAMS, K.B.O'KELL, H.E.FOOTER. Caption (page 33): The start of the 1926 Surrey County Championship at Epsom Downs
